iti96:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti96:2.1: kāmayogayutto bhikkhave bhavayogayutto āgāmī hoti āgantā itthattaṃ.
iti96:2.2: kāmayogavisaññutto bhikkhave bhavayogayutto anāgāmī hoti anāgantā itthattaṃ.
iti96:2.3: kāmayogavisaññutto bhikkhave bhavayogavisaññutto arahaṃ hoti khīṇāsavo’ti.
iti96:6.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
